definitions.explanation: The act of walking or traveling on foot. A formal or technical term used especially in official, medical, and traffic-related contexts, as opposed to the everyday verb 歩く.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歩行者|ほこうしゃ}→歩行者：03152_hokousha⟧⟦{優先|ゆうせん}→優先：15243_yuusen⟧。
⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧、{歩行|ほこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧になった。
examples.english: After the surgery, walking became difficult.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歩行者|ほこうしゃ}→歩行者：03152_hokousha⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通|とお}れません→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: This road is for pedestrians only, so bicycles cannot pass through.

notes:
A formal/technical term for walking, commonly seen in traffic signs, medical contexts, and official language. In everyday conversation, ⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ is used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{歩行者|ほこうしゃ}→歩行者：03152_hokousha⟧: pedestrian
- ⟦{歩行者|ほこうしゃ}{天国|てんごく}→歩行者天国：30635_hokoushatengoku⟧: pedestrian zone (car-free zone)
- {歩行|ほこう}⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧: walking rehabilitation/training
- {歩行|ほこう}⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧: difficulty walking
- {歩行|ほこう}⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧: walking speed
- {歩行器|ほこうき}: walker (mobility aid)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk — the everyday verb
- ⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧: a walk/stroll — implies walking for pleasure or exercise
- ⟦{徒歩|とほ}→徒歩：03031_toho⟧: on foot — used for describing how one travels (e.g., ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{徒歩|とほ}→徒歩：03031_toho⟧5⟦{分|ふん}→分：00928_fun⟧)
